title: Tanzanian Lamb Ribs Zanzibar Style
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Zanzibar Lamb Ribs — lamb ribs marinated in a Zanzibar spice paste of cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and tamarind, slow-roasted over charcoal until the meat is falling off the bone and the exterior is magnificently caramelised. Zanzibar grilling at its most spectacular.
longDesc: Zanzibar lamb ribs are the celebration grill — the lamb ribs marinated overnight in the island's spice paste and slow-roasted over charcoal. The cloves and cinnamon caramelise on the exterior while the meat becomes falling-tender within.
ingredients: 1 rack lamb ribs — separated into individual ribs
steps: Blend all spice paste ingredients to a smooth paste.
Coat lamb ribs thoroughly. Marinate minimum 4 hours — overnight best.
Grill over medium-low indirect heat 40—50 minutes, turning every 10—15 minutes.
Move to direct heat last 10 minutes for the caramelised exterior.
chefTips: Low and slow for the ribs.
The tamarind in the paste aids caramelisation.
commonMistakes: Too high heat — burns exterior before interior cooks.
cookingScience: See TZA035 for slow-roasted spiced meat science.
culturalNote: Zanzibar lamb ribs are the celebration grill of the island — when the spice paste caramelises over charcoal, the smell is the smell of every Eid celebration the island has ever had.
